type.numbers: ui-rounded, SF Pro Rounded, system-ui with tabular numerals (watch face)

layout: Desktop: header with a 12-week streak strip; a split scoreboard (this week | this month) then the training trace on the left; the sticky 'Log a run' form (watch-face distance and time, Today/Yesterday, live pace beside Save) on the right; the run sheet grouped by week full width below. Phone: header, scoreboard stacked in one panel, form, trace, sheet.
signature: Training trace: a time-true SVG chart whose week columns carry their weekly km on top (this week in ember), ember distance bars per run day and a smoothed lake-blue pace thread on an inverted right axis (faster is higher) with a dashed average-pace guide whose value is tagged on the pace axis; gold marks the longest run and fastest pace. Plus the month race: this month's cumulative km as an ember step line against last month's dashed one.
mood: Sporty and precise, like a watch face and a coach's split sheet; warm ember on calm neutrals.
